title: Echo a number
description:
Read numbers and print each one back, doubled and negated.

```
Number: 21
you typed 21, doubled 42, negated -21
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
ask:    db      "Number: ", 0

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel ask]
        call    print_str
        call    read_int
        mov     rbx, rax
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `mov rdi, rbx` then `add rdi, rdi` doubles a copy without changing `rbx`.
Each label part (`"you typed "`, `", doubled "`, ...) is its own zero-terminated string.
requirements: Keep the number in `rbx` while calling routines.
Use `add` for doubling and `neg` for negating.
stretch: Keep reading until `read_int` returns 0 in `rdx` (the end of the input), using a jump back to the start.
